name: EDU_AI_DEMO
description: Build a temporary school-branded AI chatbot demo from public website content.

spec.question_description: Official school or organization name to show in the demo.
Official public website, for example unc.edu.
Optional direct school logo image URL. Leave blank to auto-discover.

openshift_ai uses the shared OpenShift AI model and creates no VM. For a RHEL CPU comparison choose openshift_ai_and_rhel_vm, or choose rhel_vm for just the guest. rhel_ai uses an existing RHEL AI appliance.
spec.choices:
openshift_ai
rhel_ai
rhel_vm
openshift_ai_and_rhel_vm
all
openshift

spec.question_description: Bounded crawl limit for public pages.
Optional list of official page URLs for particular topics, for example admissions or financial aid.
